name: Cockatrice

variantInfo.name: Cockatrice
notes: Standard level 37 cockatrice (npc 419); the Slayer-task target.
A mirror shield or V's shield must be equipped to defend against the cockatrice's petrifying gaze.
Cockathrice is the superior variant, appearing only with the Bigger and Badder unlock active.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Cockatrice)
notes: The cockatrice area of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; 7 spawns.
A mirror shield or V's shield is required to avoid gaze damage.

taskNotes: Cockatrice are assigned by Mazchna and require 25 Slayer; a mirror shield or V's shield (20 Defence to wield) must be equipped to avoid the petrifying gaze.
The live wiki also lists Vannaka as an assigner (40-90 per task); Vannaka is outside the C3 starter-tier scope of this family and is not authored here.
Cockatrice have 37 hitpoints and a max hit of 5; they attack with stab-based melee and have no elemental weakness.
The standard cockatrice is npc 419; Cockathrice is the superior variant (Bigger and Badder unlock).
The slayerTargetId 282 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist section 1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The wikiPageId was not captured at authoring time (honest UNKNOWN); sourceUrl is https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cockatrice.
recommendedMethod: Equip a mirror shield or V's shield, then kill cockatrice in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon with any melee weapon; they have 37 HP and a max hit of 5.
